name: io.github.Irdanwen/carpe-diem-mcp
description: Venice AI models via Carpe Diem: TEE or best-price routing, spend limits, x402 pay-per-call.

environmentVariables.name: CARPE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Carpe Diem API key (cdm_…), from carpe-diem.xyz → API → Keys

environmentVariables.name: CARPE_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Session spend cap in USD (default 5, 0 = off)

environmentVariables.name: CARPE_X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet key for x402 pay-per-call, instead of an API key

environmentVariables.name: CARPE_X402_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Required with CARPE_X402_PRIVATE_KEY: total USDC the escrow may ever pull
